title: The stratum Hom composite is the normalized evaluation comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\ge1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $s:S\hookrightarrow X$ be a locally closed immersion between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, factored as $S\xrightarrow{c}V\xrightarrow{v}X$ with $c$ closed and $v$ open [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Work in ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small sites $\tau=e,p$ (etale, pro-etale) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Put $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $H_\tau=R\mathcal Hom_A$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $Q_\tau=v_{\tau,!}c_{\tau,*}$ and $J_\tau=Rc_\tau^!v_\tau^*$, with the ambient closed right adjoints and pasted counits of [lem-weil-finite-duality-locally-closed-comparison]. Let $L$ be an etale locally constant finite $A$-module sheaf with flat stalks on $S$, and let $M\in D^b_c(X_e,A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Assume $N=J_eM\in D^b_c(S_e,A)$.

Let $\Delta_L:C_XQ_eL\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_pC_SL$ and $\gamma_M:C_SN\xrightarrow{\sim}J_pC_XM$ be the canonical counit-compatible comparisons of [lem-weil-finite-duality-locally-closed-comparison]. Let $b_s:C_XRs_{e,*}H_e(L,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rs_{p,*}C_SH_e(L,N)$ be the specified ordinary direct-image mate of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. Let $\chi_\tau:H_\tau(Q_\tau P,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rs_{\tau,*}H_\tau(P,J_\tau B)$ be the canonical stratum isomorphism, specifying the normalization of the natural isomorphism in [lem-weil-stratum-ambient-hom] as follows. Put $K_\tau=H_\tau(P,J_\tau B)$ and write $\varepsilon^{\star,\tau}:s_\tau^*Rs_{\tau,*}\to1$ for the ordinary counit. The tensor transpose of $\chi_\tau^{-1}$ is
$$Rs_{\tau,*}K_\tau\otimes_A^LQ_\tau P\xrightarrow{\pi^\tau}Q_\tau(s_\tau^*Rs_{\tau,*}K_\tau\otimes_A^LP)\xrightarrow{Q_\tau(\varepsilon^{\star,\tau}\otimes1)}Q_\tau(K_\tau\otimes_A^LP)\xrightarrow{Q_\tau(\mathrm{ev})}Q_\tau J_\tau B\xrightarrow{\epsilon^\tau_B}B,$$
using the projection isomorphism of [lem-sf-immersion-projection-site-comparison] and the pasted exceptional counit $\epsilon^\tau$. Let $\beta$ denote the evaluation transpose of [def-sf-evaluation-hom-site-comparison]. Then, as morphisms in $D(X_p,A)$,
$$\chi_p\circ H_p(\Delta_L^{-1},1)\circ\beta_{Q_eL,M}
=Rs_{p,*}\!\bigl(H_p(1,\gamma_M)\circ\beta_{L,N}\bigr)\circ b_s\circ C_X(\chi_e).$$
The identity uses the canonical tensor identifications throughout. All the displayed arrows are isomorphisms whenever $\beta_{L,N}$ is; in that case $\beta_{Q_eL,M}$ is an isomorphism. Only the ambient closed right adjoints entering $J_\tau$ are used.

proof.text: Finite type over the coefficient field makes X Noetherian; the locally closed immersion is quasi-compact. The tensor-left adjunction and the degree-zero bound show H_e(L,J_e M) is bounded below by DerivedCategory.isGE_obj_of_adjunction.

Conjugate the immersion projection isomorphism by the derived/exact extension isomorphisms. Its naturality and invertibility allow the existing parametrized tensor-Hom conjugate-isomorphism construction to give chi on each site. The counit formula is exactly the inverse-transpose normalization for the actual supplied right adjoints.
Apply the normalized stratum pairing identity with these two constructed isomorphisms and the boundedness witness. This supplies just the displayed equality.

If beta on the stratum is invertible, then stratumMap is invertible since gamma is. The fixed ordinary mate is invertible for the qcqs immersion. Functors preserve these inverses. The two chi components and homChange are invertible. The displayed equality and cancellation therefore make ambient beta invertible and establish all seven requested IsIso clauses.
